column1: # appends `line` to that page's `what_to_watch` frontmatter array via
# append_what_to_watch (JSON, never regex). One row per page: the 10 US
# state/city pages on Plasma One's own 31-state allow-list (help 14703938,
# config/availability.yaml cards.plasma) plus `usa`, worded for "one of
# Plasma One's 31 supported US states" instead of a single state name.
# Money figures (2 %, 0.1 %, $10) are the literal numbers in
# "Что нельзя печатать" list (no "free card", no "up to 4 %", no "180+
# countries", no "6 % yield") is honored: this line names none of them.
# ether.fi stays each page's primary CTA (Spain control law, G12) — this is
# a SECOND card, appended to what_to_watch, never the primary CTA block.
